title: Plan & Prompt
lesson: A sequence is a list of instructions in order. Plan a route, run it, then fix one mistake at a time.
goal: Move the robot to the beacon.
rule: Give three steps. Do not include personal details.

title: Power & Logic
lesson: A variable stores a value. True can be represented by 1 and false by 0. AND needs both conditions; OR needs at least one; NOT reverses true and false.
goal: Open the gate using energy and a key.
rule: Use a playground example and two short sentences.

title: Choices & Characters
lesson: IF chooses an action when a condition is true. ELSE handles the other case. SWITCH chooses among named cases, like red, yellow and green signals.
goal: Choose the right gate rule and test it.
prompt: Help me design a tricky gate
rule: Use OR. Give a hint, not the answer.

title: Loops & Tools
lesson: REPEAT runs a set number of times. WHILE checks before each turn. DO / WHILE runs once before checking. A function gives reusable steps a name.
goal: Use repeat to reach the beacon with fewer blocks.
rule: Ask one question before suggesting a fix.

title: Playtest & Share
lesson: Combine your rules into an adventure. Test normal cases and tricky cases. Explain what you changed and why. Check AI suggestions rather than assuming they are correct.
goal: Build a route and explain your design to a classmate.
rule: Suggest one improvement and one test. Do not solve it for me.
